title: Sourdough Zucchini Bread

directions: Preheat oven to 350°F (176°C) and lightly grease a 9x5-inch loaf pan.
Grate 1 3/4 cups zucchini using the large holes of a cheese grater. Place in a colander and squeeze out excess moisture. Leave in the colander while you mix the remaining ingredients.
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, baking soda, fine sea salt, cinnamon, and chopped walnuts.

In a separate bowl, mix light brown sugar, 2 large eggs, sourdough starter discard, 2 tsp vanilla extract, and avocado oil with a spatula until smooth. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until just combined. Stir in the grated zucchini.

Pour the batter into the greased baking pan and bake for 55–60 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Cool for 10–15 minutes before transferring to a cooling rack. Slice and serve.

notes: All-purpose flour can be substituted with bread flour. After mixing and pouring into the baking dish, you can cold ferment it in the fridge overnight. This recipe uses sourdough discard — active starter also works. Store at room temperature for 1–2 days or refrigerate for up to 7 days. Freeze for up to 3 months.
